frontmatter: description: "Every call of the TFStudio API in the Script Console: what it takes, what it returns and what it refuses."
intro: Every call on `tf` in the [Script Console](/automation/script-console/), with what it takes, what it returns and what it refuses. A call that changes a design returns a new one and leaves the one it was given as it was; set `tf.design` to the new one to keep it. Wavelengths and layer thicknesses are in nm, angles in degrees in the incident medium, the substrate thickness in mm, and R, T and A are fractions of 1, in merit targets too.

A call refuses an option it does not know and a value it cannot use, with an error that says what it takes, so nothing runs on a value you did not mean. Each example runs on the open design; one that ends by setting `tf.design` changes it, as one undo step.
en.allMethods: Each of {ids} in turn, from the same start, keeping the best

frontmatter: description: "脚本控制台中 TFStudio API 的每一个调用：接受什么、返回什么、拒绝什么。"
intro: [脚本控制台](/automation/script-console/)中 `tf` 上的每一个调用：它接受什么、返回什么、拒绝什么。改变设计的调用返回一个新设计，传入的设计保持不变；把 `tf.design` 设为新设计即可保留它。波长和膜层厚度单位为 nm，角度为入射介质中的度数，基底厚度单位为 mm，R、T 和 A 用 0 到 1 之间的小数表示，评价函数目标值也是如此。
调用会拒绝它不认识的选项和无法使用的值，并给出说明它接受什么的错误信息，因此不会用你无意给出的值运行。每个示例都在打开的设计上运行；以设置 `tf.design` 结尾的示例会改变它，作为一个撤销步骤。
zh.allMethods: 依次运行 {ids}，从同一起点开始，保留最好的结果
